articleTitle: Is Declining a $300 Bar Tab From a Stranger a Rejection?
imageHeadline: Declining a gift isn't rejecting the person
imageSubtext: It's setting a boundary about how you want to meet someone
pinTitle: Is Declining a $300 Bar Tab From a Stranger a Rejection? What Gift Acceptance Really Signals
pinDescription: A stranger offers to cover your bar tab so you'll stay and talk. You say no. Does that mean you're not interested? Here's what declining a gift actually communicates in early dating—and why boundaries aren't the same as rejection. Read the full breakdown of reciprocity, expectations, and how to navigate these moments.

items.label: Declining sets a boundary, not a romantic verdict
Big gestures from strangers can trigger obligation
You can say no to the tab and yes to conversation
